name: growthbook-skills
description: 22 agent skills for GrowthBook — full feature flag lifecycle (create, target, schedule, ramp, monitor, publish, clean up) and A/B experiment management (brainstorm, design, launch, analyze, stop). Calls the GrowthBook REST API directly; no MCP server required.

plugins.name: growthbook
plugins.description: Full-lifecycle playbooks for GrowthBook feature flags and experiments. Covers draft revisions, approval workflows, force/rollout rules, timed schedules, multi-step ramps with hold-for-approval gates, monitored rollouts, experiment-ref wiring, dependency graphing, stale-flag audits, and end-to-end experiment launch → analyze → stop → ship. All skills call the REST API through a bundled helper; no extra dependencies beyond Node 18.
